description: We're planning a row of six two-storey townhouses on one lot, and every unit will have a legal basement suite. We'd like to build every party wall the same way, as a 1-hour rated double-stud wall running from the footing to the underside of the roof deck, instead of making some of them full firewalls. Is there a way to get that approved?
known_facts: each house has a secondary suite
1 h party walls from footing to roof deck proposed for all

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

missing_info.field: tested wall assembly listing for the 1 h party wall

gold.departure: Party walls between every pair of houses with secondary suites built as 1 h fire separations; no firewalls dividing the row into buildings of not more than 2 houses.

should_cite.why: the 1 h party-wall option the applicant is extending

gold.engineering_reason: Six dwelling units in one building (secondary suites aside) exceeds the four-unit exemption, so authenticated drawings are required.

authoring.author: Batatis evaluation builder (Claude Opus 5.5)
authoring.notes: Written from the code database only; held-out judge set not consulted.
